title.en: The Right Call at the Wrong Hour
title.zh: 深夜里刚好接到的电话

text.en: It is way too late, your brain has 80 tabs open, and your phone lights up: {partner} calling, just to hear how you're holding up.
text.zh: 夜已经太深，脑子里开着 80 个 tab，手机突然亮了——是 {partner}，就想听听你还撑不撑得住。

text.en: Pick up and actually talk
text.zh: 接起来，好好聊聊

resultText.en: Twenty minutes of {partner}'s nonsense and your shoulders finally drop. The notes will survive without you.
resultText.zh: {partner} 胡说八道二十分钟，你的肩膀终于塌了下来。笔记没你也不会跑。

text.en: Quick goodnight, back to studying
text.zh: 道个晚安，继续复习

resultText.en: You keep it short and get a bit more done, but you can hear {partner} miss you through the phone.
resultText.zh: 你长话短说多看了一点，可电话那头 {partner} 的想念你也听得出来。

text.en: Let it ring, you're in the zone
text.zh: 让它响，你正在状态里

resultText.en: You finish the section, then feel a small guilty pang at the missed-call notification glowing back at you.
resultText.zh: 你啃完这一节，再看到那条未接来电的提示，心里轻轻咯噔了一下。

text.en: {partner} has ambushed your study spot with a suspicious paper bag and the energy of someone who is very proud of themselves.
text.zh: {partner} 拎着一个可疑纸袋突袭了你的自习角落，一脸 '我太机智了' 的得意。

text.en: Take a proper snack break together
text.zh: 正经地一起吃顿零食

resultText.en: Warm snacks, dumb jokes, ten real minutes of not being a student. You go back lighter.
resultText.zh: 热乎的零食、傻乎乎的笑话、十分钟真正不当学生的时间。回去时整个人都轻了。

text.en: Eat at your desk, keep grinding
text.zh: 边吃边在桌前继续啃

resultText.en: You snack one-handed and flip flashcards with the other. Efficient, slightly crumb-covered, a little sad.
resultText.zh: 一手抓零食一手翻卡片。效率是有了，碎屑也有了，就是有点心酸。

text.en: Walk {partner} home, then return
text.zh: 送 {partner} 回去，再回来

resultText.en: A slow walk and fresh air cost you study time but reset your whole nervous system.
resultText.zh: 慢慢走一段、吹吹风，花掉了复习时间，却把整个神经系统都重启了。

title.zh: 异地的日历俄罗斯方块

text.en: You and {partner} are in different cities, two calendars that refuse to agree, trying to find one weekend that works.
text.zh: 你和 {partner} 在两座城市，两份死活对不上的日历，正努力凑出一个都行的周末。

text.en: Book the trip even if money's tight
text.zh: 钱紧也先把车票订了

resultText.en: The ticket pings into your inbox and suddenly the whole month has a finish line worth running toward.
resultText.zh: 车票确认信息一进邮箱，整个月突然有了一个值得冲的终点。

text.en: Settle for a long video-call night
text.zh: 退一步，约个视频长夜

resultText.en: Two screens, two cheap dinners, one shared movie out of sync by three seconds. It counts.
resultText.zh: 两块屏幕、两份廉价晚饭、一部差了三秒的电影。这也算约会。

text.en: Push it back until exams clear
text.zh: 推到考试结束再说

resultText.en: Sensible for your grades, quietly heavy for both of you. {partner} understands, which somehow makes it worse.
resultText.zh: 对成绩很理智，对你俩都有点闷。{partner} 表示理解，反而更让你心里发酸。

title.en: A Date on a Student Budget

text.en: {partner} proposes a date with a budget roughly the size of a vending-machine coffee. Challenge accepted.
text.zh: {partner} 提议来场约会，预算大概等于自动贩卖机一杯咖啡。挑战接受。

text.en: Grocery-store picnic in the park
text.zh: 超市采购，公园野餐

resultText.en: Bread, two snacks, one bench, zero stress. Easily the best three dollars of the semester.
resultText.zh: 面包、两份小零食、一条长椅、零压力。绝对是这学期花得最值的几块钱。

text.en: Turn it into a cozy study date
text.zh: 改成温馨自习约会

resultText.en: You both read in comfortable silence, knees touching under the table. Productive and quietly lovely.
resultText.zh: 你俩在舒服的沉默里各看各的，桌下膝盖轻轻挨着。又高产又默默地甜。

text.en: Splurge on one nice dessert to share
text.zh: 奢侈一次，合吃一份好甜点

resultText.en: One fancy slice, two forks, an embarrassing amount of joy. Worth blowing the budget.
resultText.zh: 一块讲究的甜点、两把叉子、过分多的快乐。超预算也认了。

text.en: You catch yourself feeling guilty for being so buried lately. {partner} hasn't complained once, which somehow makes you feel guiltier.
text.zh: 你突然觉得最近埋头太久、有点亏欠。{partner} 一句没抱怨，反而让你更过意不去。

text.en: Send an honest, soft text about it
text.zh: 发条坦白又温柔的消息

resultText.en: {partner} replies that loving a busy person is not a hardship, it's just timing. Your chest unknots.
resultText.zh: {partner} 回你：爱一个忙人不是受苦，只是时机问题。你胸口那个结松开了。

text.en: Plan an elaborate make-up day
text.zh: 策划一个隆重的补偿日

resultText.en: Ambitious plans, real money, real fun, but you both know presence beats production value.
resultText.zh: 计划宏大、真金白银、也真的开心，可你俩都明白：人在场，比排场重要。

text.en: Say nothing, just power through
text.zh: 啥也不说，硬扛过去

resultText.en: You bury it under more flashcards. The guilt doesn't leave; it just files itself away for later.
resultText.zh: 你用更多卡片把它埋了。愧疚没走，只是给自己存了个档，留着以后再说。

title.en: The Tooth Can Wait, Your Brain Cannot

text.en: It is 1 a.m. {partner} texts: 'the tooth can wait, your nervous system cannot. go to sleep.'
text.zh: 凌晨一点，{partner} 发来：'牙能等，你的神经系统不能。去睡觉。'

text.en: Actually listen and go to bed
text.zh: 真的听话，去睡了

resultText.en: You close the laptop mid-sentence. Tomorrow-you will write a thank-you note to past-you.
resultText.zh: 你在句子写一半时合上电脑。明天的你会给今天的你写封感谢信。

text.en: Negotiate 'just one more hour'
text.zh: 讨价还价 '就再一小时'

resultText.en: One hour becomes ninety minutes. You learn a little more and sleep a little worse.
resultText.zh: 一小时拖成了九十分钟。多学了一点，也睡得差了一点。

text.en: Send a tragic study selfie back
text.zh: 回一张悲壮的学习自拍

resultText.en: {partner} replies with three crying-laughing faces and a firm 'BED. NOW.' You comply, grinning.
resultText.zh: {partner} 回了三个笑哭，外加坚定的 '上。床。现。在。' 你笑着照办了。

title.en: A Win Worth a Tiny Party
title.zh: 值得开个小派对的胜利

text.en: You passed the thing, or nailed one tricky procedure, and {partner} insists this absolutely requires celebrating.
text.zh: 你过了那个考核，或者搞定了一个棘手操作，{partner} 坚持这绝对值得庆祝一下。

text.en: Let {partner} make a fuss
text.zh: 让 {partner} 大张旗鼓一回

resultText.en: A goofy little toast and genuine pride in {partner}'s eyes. You let yourself feel competent for once.
resultText.zh: 一句傻气的祝酒词，加上 {partner} 眼里真心的骄傲。你难得允许自己觉得 '我挺行的'。

text.en: Shrug it off, it's not a big deal
text.zh: 摆摆手，没什么大不了

resultText.en: {partner} gently disagrees and celebrates anyway, but you keep half the joy locked in modesty.
resultText.zh: {partner} 温柔地不同意，照样庆祝，可你把一半的开心锁在了谦虚里。

text.en: Toast fast, next exam looms
text.zh: 速干一杯，下个考试在逼近

resultText.en: Five minutes of celebration, then back to the grind. The momentum stays; the warmth fades quickly.
resultText.zh: 庆祝五分钟，回去接着卷。势头留下了，暖意散得快了点。

title.zh: 一条会错意的消息，悄悄理顺

text.en: A tired one-word reply from you landed wrong, and {partner} seems a little off. It's small, but it's sitting there.
text.zh: 你累到只回了一个字，结果被误会了，{partner} 好像有点不对劲。事不大，但就那么悬着。

text.en: Call and clear it up kindly
text.zh: 打个电话，好好说开

resultText.en: Two minutes of honesty: you were just fried, not cold. {partner} laughs, relieved, and so are you.
resultText.zh: 两分钟坦白：你只是累瘫了，不是冷淡。{partner} 松口气笑了，你也是。

text.en: Defuse it with a dumb meme
text.zh: 甩个沙雕表情包化解

resultText.en: The meme works instantly, but the real conversation stays politely postponed for another day.
resultText.zh: 表情包当场奏效，可那场真正的对话还是被礼貌地往后挪了。

text.en: Assume it'll blow over on its own
text.zh: 觉得过两天自己就好了

resultText.en: It probably will, but you both carry a low hum of awkwardness through the evening.
resultText.zh: 大概是会好，可一整晚你俩都背着一丝低低的别扭。

title.en: Letting Someone Carry a Tab for You
title.zh: 让别人替你扛一个 tab

text.en: You are visibly running on fumes, and {partner} offers to handle dinner, errands, everything, so you can breathe. Accepting feels weirdly hard.
text.zh: 你明显已经在用爱发电了，{partner} 主动包揽晚饭、跑腿、一切，让你喘口气。可接受这份好意竟然莫名地难。

text.en: Accept, and just say thank you
text.zh: 接受，然后好好说声谢谢

resultText.en: You let yourself be taken care of for one evening. Turns out, you don't have to earn rest. Suspiciously mature.
resultText.zh: 你允许自己被照顾了一晚。原来休息不用 '挣'。这操作意外地成熟。

text.en: Accept half, insist on doing the rest
text.zh: 接受一半，剩下硬要自己来

resultText.en: A reasonable compromise that helps a bit, though {partner} side-eyes you for still doing the dishes.
resultText.zh: 一个合理的折中，确实缓了点，不过 {partner} 还是斜眼看你那个非要洗碗的样子。

text.en: Politely decline, you've got it
text.zh: 礼貌拒绝，你能搞定

resultText.en: You handle it all yourself like always. Independent, technically fine, and quietly more tired than you admit.
resultText.zh: 你像往常一样全自己扛了。独立、勉强算行，只是比你承认的更累一点。

title.en: I Am Losing a Fight With a Tiny Tooth
title.zh: 我正在输给一颗小小的牙

text.en: Sim lab is humbling you. You draft a dramatic text to {partner}: 'send help, I am losing a fight with a tiny tooth.'
text.zh: sim lab 把你按在地上摩擦。你给 {partner} 打了条戏精消息：'快来救我，我正在输给一颗小小的牙。'

text.en: Send the dramatic text
text.zh: 把这条戏精消息发出去

resultText.en: {partner} replies: 'believe in the tooth's eventual defeat, soldier.' You laugh, breathe, and your hands steady.
resultText.zh: {partner} 回：'相信这颗牙终将落败，战士。' 你笑出声、喘口气，手也稳了。

text.en: Full voice-memo meltdown rant
text.zh: 录段语音，彻底崩溃吐槽

resultText.en: You unload two minutes of despair; {partner} listens to all of it. Cathartic, if mildly unhinged.
resultText.zh: 你倾倒了两分钟的绝望，{partner} 全程听完。很解压，就是有点癫。

text.en: Delete it, just try again quietly
text.zh: 删掉，默默再练一次

resultText.en: You reset and repeat the drill. The skill creeps up a notch, but no one talked you off the ledge.
resultText.zh: 你重置好再练一遍。手感悄悄涨了一格，只是没人把你从崩溃边缘劝下来。
